race.title: Chris Down A Lifetime In Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: TORRENT made an impressive start over fences when scoring at Uttoxeter last week, going with plenty of enthusiasm in front, so he is taken to follow up with more still to offer. The biggest threat could come from Silver Hill , who wasn't seen to best effect on chasing debut, while Champagne Chic is interesting with his recent run behind him. TORRENT SILVER HILL (IRE) CHAMPAGNE CHIC (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Torrent (5/2), Rickety Bridge (3/1), Silver Hill (4/1), Solar System (9/2), Red Dirt Road (6/1), Champagne Chic (12/1)
